description: Discover the best hotels in Bali, Indonesia. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Bali: Luxury Private Pool Villa with Two Pools, Waterslide & Fitness Centre
hotels.description: Step into Villa Zeno Arete, a playground of luxury in Pererenan, Bali. With six king-bed suites, two glass-bottom pools, a slide straight from the master bedroom, a jacuzzi, sauna and ice bath, this villa is all about recovery, fun and living it up. Gym sessions, pool parties or chill vibes - it’s your call. More than just a place to stay, Villa Zeno Arete comes with full-time staff and a chef available on request. Whether you’re training hard, entertaining friends or simply soaking up the Bali sun, every corner of this villa is made for maximum luxury and good vibes.

hotels.title: Elegant Javanese-Inspired Private Pool Villa in Canggu for Up To 10 Guests
hotels.description: Tropical Svasti brings together the warmth of traditional Javanese design and the ease of contemporary villa living in vibrant Canggu. Gather beneath the characterful Joglo pavilion, where the open-plan lounge, dining area and kitchen create a natural hub for relaxed days with family or friends. The expansive villa opens onto a private swimming pool and lush outdoor spaces, while thoughtful touches include complimentary breakfast, in-villa dining and wellness experiences available by request. With five bedrooms, space for up to 10 guests and a serene atmosphere, it’s an inviting base for an easygoing Bali escape.

hotels.title: Bali: Seminyak Private Pool Villa with Butler Service for Up To 10 Guests
hotels.description: Situated in Seminyak’s Nakula district, this contemporary villa retreat places you within easy reach of Double Six Beach and the boutiques, cafés and galleries of the local area. Each villa features separate living areas and pools, creating a polished base between mornings by the water and afternoons exploring Bali’s stylish south-west coast. Seminyak’s dining scene is close at hand, from inventive Indonesian plates at Merah Putih to beachfront drinks and seafood at La Plancha. For evenings out, Petitenget’s celebrated restaurants, including Sardine and Métis, sit a short drive away beside chic bars and designer stores.

hotels.title: Bali: Five-Bedroom Tropical Private Pool Villa Near Rice Fields
hotels.description: Set quietly beside Bali’s rice fields, Villa Umah Daun brings sculptural architecture and spacious tropical living together in a striking private retreat. Designed by Balinese architect Komang Suardika, its curved rooftops and flowing pavilions blend stone, timber and water around a central swimming pool. The soaring leaf-shaped living pavilion creates an atmospheric setting for shared meals and relaxed gatherings, with a long dining table overlooking the pool and a professionally equipped kitchen for easy dining. Families are thoughtfully catered for with a colourful playroom, cosy mezzanine and children’s wading pool, while the five-bedroom layout offers space to reconnect in comfort.

hotels.title: Refined Bali Airport Haven with Outdoor Pool, Two Bars & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Be perfectly placed for exploration at this tropical hotel, conveniently located just steps from I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport. This serene oasis offers a refreshing retreat from the hustle of Kuta, with a glittering outdoor pool, modern fitness centre and onsite spa. Savour authentic Indonesian cuisine at the onsite restaurant, The Square, or sip on a refreshing drink at the Run@way Bar or GOURMETBAR. Venture beyond the hotel to discover the vibrant beach clubs of Seminyak or the majestic Uluwatu Temple, both within easy reach.

hotels.title: Beachfront Legian Family-Friendly Paradise with 10 Restaurants and Bars, Outdoor Pools & Spa
hotels.description: Perfectly set on the golden sands of Legian Beach, this lively yet tranquil escape embraces the vibrant spirit of Bali. Spread across 10 acres of lush tropical gardens, this beachfront retreat blends authentic Balinese hospitality with a laid-back atmosphere in the heart of Legian - an ideal base for surfers, sunseekers and culture lovers alike. Spend days unwinding by sparkling pools or at Usadha Spa, then sample your way through the hotel's 10 diverse restaurants and bars. Step beyond the resort to discover bustling markets, renowned surf spots and a rich mix of local dining. For family-friendly fun, head to Waterbom Bali, or enjoy a shopping spree at the stylish Discovery Mall.

hotels.title: Seminyak: Tropical Private Pool Villa Retreat with Space for Up To 10 Guests
hotels.description: Tucked into Seminyak’s Nakula district, this private villa stay places you within easy reach of Double Six Beach and the boutiques, cafés and galleries lining Jalan Camplung Tanduk. Contemporary interiors pair with a secluded pool and generous living spaces, creating a polished base in one of Bali’s most sought-after enclaves. Nearby, dine on refined Indonesian fare at Made’s Warung or settle in for wood-fired Italian plates at Mozzarella by the Sea. Seminyak Village, Petitenget Temple and the beach clubs of Jalan Petitenget are all within convenient reach

hotels.title: Bali Central Kuta Sanctuary with Onsite Restaurant & Bars, Oceanview Infinity Pool & Day Spa
hotels.description: Balinese bliss awaits at this sophisticated Kuta staqy. Perfectly position on Bali’s most beloved beach, Mercure Kuta is just moments from all the island’s best action, including fantastic food, aquatic activities and a thriving nightlife. Take a dip in the spectacular infinity pool, then retire to the onsite spa for a rejuvenating treatment. Watch a famous Bali sunset from ocean-facing Alang Alang Restaurant, savouring fragrant Asian and international dishes, then retire to your comfortable room for a restful evening in paradise.

hotels.title: Bali: Light-Filled Contemporary Seminyak Villa with Private Pool for Up To 10 Guests
hotels.description: Set in the lush calm of Bali, Villa Swarna by Nakula pairs crisp white interiors with warm natural timber for a serene, light-filled retreat. The upper-level bedrooms feature traditional Balinese thatched roofs and open onto a private balcony overlooking the garden courtyard - an inviting spot for breakfast or afternoon tea. Both bathrooms include a bathtub beside a geometric cut-out wall, allowing natural light and air to flow through. On the lower level, a bedroom opens to a small courtyard and features an outdoor shower with dual access points, all finished finished with luxury-resort-style amenities.

hotels.title: Secluded Nusa Dua Luxury Villas with Private Pools Moments From the Beach
hotels.description: Hidden among the refined resorts of Nusa Dua, Vinila Nusa Dua offers a tranquil tropical escape centred around a beautiful outdoor swimming pool and lush gardens. Relaxed living spaces pair contemporary design with elegant furnishings and distinctive art, creating a comfortable base for slow, easygoing days in Bali. Choose from spacious villa styles designed for couples, families or groups, with generous interiors, private pool views and plenty of room to unwind. The peaceful garden setting gives every stay a sense of privacy and calm.

hotels.vendor_name: Novotel Bali Nusa Dua - Hotel & Residences
hotels.title: Idyllic Novotel Bali Escape in the Heart of Nusa Dua with Lagoon Pool & Four Onsite Eateries
hotels.description: Experience one of the world’s favourite beach destinations with a stay at this sun-drenched paradise, set amid five hectares of lush gardens surrounding a sprawling two-tier lagoon pool. Close to a private beach club that's reachable by complimentary shuttle, this escape guarantees fun in the sun. Dine across four mouthwatering restaurants, including The Square - serving Balinese and international favourites - and fresh delights at Gourmet Bar, where drinks are served poolside. Little ones will adore the hotel's family-friendly facilities, including a fun-filled kids' club boasting a wealth of daily activities.

hotels.title: Secluded Bali Seaside Hideaway with Beach Access, Onsite Dining & Day Spa
hotels.description: Experience the tranquillity of Bali's east coast at this five-star Hyatt property, a serene sanctuary set between the sea and magnificent Mount Agung. Each suite and room boasts traditional Balinese design, with private terraces offering breathtaking ocean or garden views. Indulge in authentic Indonesian cuisine at Seasalt Restaurant, or enjoy a cocktail at the oceanfront bar. Then venture beyond the resort to discover the Tirta Gangga Water Palace, or explore the local market at Candidasa. Return to enjoy traditional massages and treatments to rejuvenate your mind, body and soul, or take a dip in the pool overlooking the sparkling sea.

hotels.title: Contemporary Seminyak Villa with Private Pool for Up To Ten Guests
hotels.description: Set in Seminyak’s sought-after Petitenget district, this contemporary private villa places you moments from Batu Belig Beach and the boutiques, galleries and cafés lining Jalan Petitenget. Clean-lined interiors open to a secluded pool and tropical garden, with generous living spaces designed for easy indoor-outdoor days. Nearby, savour wood-fired plates at Sardine, modern Indonesian cuisine at Merah Putih or beachfront dining at Potato Head Beach Club. Petitenget Temple is a short drive away, while Seminyak Village and the polished bars of Jalan Kayu Aya bring designer shopping and late-night dining within easy reach.
